evidenceClasses.analysis-scope: Boundary preserving lineage uncertainty and undefined Historical Load.
evidenceClasses.declared-analysis-profile: Versioned policy defining the bounded regime comparison.
evidenceClasses.declared-equivalence-key: Onto2D projection under an explicit identity regime.
evidenceClasses.exact-first-four-targets: Deterministic equality over HMID target positions 1-4; target position is not edit time and the projection is not an observed division.
evidenceClasses.geo-sample-record: Native specimen identity from the GEO sample record.
evidenceClasses.gestmaster-row: One exact matched cell row in the pinned ZF1 GestMaster member.
evidenceClasses.source-cluster-ident: Numeric ClusterIdent reported for the matched cell.
evidenceClasses.source-hmid: Exact ten-target HMID string reported for the matched cell.

identityRegimes.cell-record: Every matched source cell remains a distinct observation.
identityRegimes.first-four-target-signature: A transparent bounded projection groups cells by the first four target positions without treating target order as edit time or claiming the published maximum-parsimony topology.
identityRegimes.observed-barcode-state: Cells with byte-equal reported barcode states are grouped together; collisions and barcode saturation prevent treating equality as a complete pedigree proof.
identityRegimes.transcriptomic-cluster: Cells are grouped by the published analysis' cluster membership; this is not a claim of common ancestry.

boundary.note: Shared cluster is not ancestry; shared barcode is not a unique-parent proof; targets 1-4 form a positional projection, not an edit-time ordering; Historical Load remains undefined.
boundary.summary: The same 750 observations form 750, 56, 192, or 133 identity classes depending on the declared key.
boundary.title: Cell / state / barcode / reconstruction boundary
